description: Trivela edge caching for static campaign assets

rules.description: Hashed frontend build assets (Vite emits content-hashed filenames) are immutable
Campaign media uploads: cache at the edge, revalidate in browsers
Dynamic API and probe routes must never be cached
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/health" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/health/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/metrics")
